'''Unit 4416''' was a [[B1-series battle droid/Legends|B1-series battle droid]] in service of the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. Stationed aboard [[Tambor Deep Space Centre]], it assisted [[Gorgol/Legends|Gorgol the Handy]] in defense against the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] [[Siege of Tambor Deep Space Centre|siege]]. After the Republic forces seemingly broke for a run, Gorgol assigned two droid squads to investigate if their enemy was really gone. Unit 4416 led one such squad and reported the left flank to be clear, moments before being destroyed by the [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]].
